text: You decided to point them upstairs.
You step back. Out of the glass. And you look at Safwan.
You tell Grete, the man you want is upstairs.
Lida, the serving girl, runs for Marta's keys.
Three lanterns climb the stairs. Safwan climbs with them. He doesn't look back.
The bolt. The key. The door swings in.
The stranger is gone. The window is open.
But someone is lying on the floor.
Grete waves you in. Clerk. Bring your pen.
You can't. It's his room. And he never invited you.
Your foot stops at the doorway like it's hit glass.
Otto opens his eyes. He sees you in the doorway.
The only man in Rabenfels who knows what you buy from him.
He pulls Lida close and whispers something.
Grete wants you inside. Lida knows something. What's your next move?
